competencies.name: Plasma and blood functions
competencies.can: State the three functional categories of blood, transport, regulation, and protection, and name the major plasma proteins and the function of each.

competencies.name: Hematocrit and formed elements
competencies.can: Define hematocrit and interpret a value as normal or abnormal in the context of anemia and dehydration.

competencies.name: Erythrocyte structure and hemoglobin
competencies.can: Relate the biconcave shape and absent nucleus of the erythrocyte to its function and describe how the four heme groups of hemoglobin carry oxygen.

competencies.name: Erythropoiesis and its regulation
competencies.can: Trace the erythropoietin negative feedback loop from tissue hypoxia to increased red cell production and state the nutrients required.

competencies.name: Red cell destruction and bilirubin
competencies.can: Trace the fate of hemoglobin after red cell breakdown and explain how failure to clear bilirubin produces jaundice.

competencies.name: Leukocytes
competencies.can: Match neutrophils, lymphocytes, monocytes, eosinophils, and basophils to their defensive function and to the condition that raises each.

competencies.name: Hemostasis
competencies.can: Order the three phases of hemostasis, vascular spasm, platelet plug formation, and coagulation, and identify the role of von Willebrand factor and thromboxane.

competencies.name: Coagulation cascade
competencies.can: Compare the intrinsic and extrinsic pathways to the common pathway and identify the roles of thrombin, fibrin, calcium, and vitamin K.

competencies.name: Clot limitation and fibrinolysis
competencies.can: Explain how anticoagulants and plasmin limit and remove a clot and predict the effect of a drug that blocks vitamin K or platelet aggregation.

competencies.name: ABO and Rh blood types
competencies.can: Predict agglutination for any donor and recipient ABO and Rh combination and explain the mechanism of hemolytic disease of the newborn.

competencies.name: Hematocrit and hemoglobin determination
competencies.can: Determine hematocrit and hemoglobin from a sample or simulation and evaluate the result against reference ranges.

competencies.name: Blood typing
competencies.can: Perform simulated ABO and Rh typing and determine compatible donor types for the result obtained.
